Downside

✓DeliveredCredit stage · basis: FY2026, net debt 1,739 and cash interest 140 held in every case

The first break is net debt / EBITDA at the 6.0x covenant: EBITDA can fall 23.3%, to 290, before the limit is reached, and the 2.0x cover test follows at a 25.9% fall to 280. Headroom on both is lower than in the earlier run. The severe case (a 24% fall) breaches leverage; the combined case (30%) breaches both tests. Show sources

Key findings

  • Net leverage is the first break, at a 23.3% fall in EBITDA; cover follows at 25.9%.
  • The severe case, a 24% fall, is already past the leverage limit (6.05x against 6.0x) and just inside the cover limit (2.05x against 2.0x).
  • The combined case breaches both tests and leaves committed resources at 266.

Contrary evidence and what would change the view

  • Cash interest is held at 140; a lower rate bill would widen the cover test, not the leverage test.
  • Debt of 150 falls due in 2027 (revolving facility 50, other debt 100): a refinancing that adds debt would bring the first break closer.

Catalysts

  • 2027: debt of 150 falls due, so a refinancing decision precedes any stress.
  • 2028: the term loan B of 640 falls due.
  • A second-half decline in orders would first show in EBITDA, then in net debt / EBITDA.

Limitations of this module

As the module reports them
Cash interest not stressedNot established: the module held cash interest at 140 in every case and wrote no rate shock.

Maturity wall not testedNot established: the module did not test whether 150 due in 2027 can be refinanced in a stressed case.
